Riding on Dennis Kelly ’s rollercoaster monologue “Girls & Boys,” Mulligan gives a phenomenal, unpredictable solo performance — a proper feat of acting — as a woman so self-assured she might just smash the patriarchy apart single-handedly.

It will spoil your experience of this fine play if I reveal what Kelly deliberately holds back, letting your mind whirr round various possibilities. cn.t: Mulligan delivers a blazing, phenomenal performance in Kelly's monologue that starts as stand-up comedy before taking a brutal, devastating turn into domestic violence, though some critics find the structure oddly paced.

vr.q: I give girls and boys five stars
